title: Deel Dealt New Setbacks in Rippling Case Over Alleged Spying
description: Deel Inc. was hit with new setbacks in Rippling Inc.’s corporate espionage litigation against the HR startup.

title: Alabama Says TikTok to Pay Up to $300 Million for Kid Safety
description: Alabama’s attorney general said TikTok has agreed to pay up to $300 million and adopt new user protection measures to settle the state’s child-safety lawsuit that was set for a jury trial to begin Monday.

title: Exxon Signs Shale Deal With Azerbaijan for Middle Kura Basin
description: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. agreed to pump oil and natural gas from Azerbaijan’s shale fields as the Texas energy giant takes its fracking expertise overseas.
